extracted.name: Mezcal & verdita
extracted.description: Verdita has become a modern classic on the menus of tequila and mezcal bars. It's a shot of 'little green' served alongside a shot of mezcal, meant to be sipped side by side
instruction_lines: To make the verdita, put all the ingredients into a blender and blitz until well-combined. Strain into a 700ml bottle through a fine mesh strainer or cheesecloth and chill until cold.
Once the verdita is well-chilled, serve it in a 25ml shot glass alongside the mezcal.
